title: Inconsistent references need per-object corrections (the plumb tower)
summary: The reference drew the guard tower plumb on screen though the camera needs roll. Tip that one object (~5 deg) to match the picture, pivoting on the edge that stays on the ground.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: guardTower(S, G, { pos, ry: .25, scale: .9, lean: -.09 })   // module.recon.prison-props

doc.when: One object disagrees with the global camera that fits everything else.
doc.avoid: Re-solving the camera for one object.
gotchas: Pivot the tilt on the base edge that stays on the surface (an embedded base reads as floating).

problem.symptom: A tall object leans more in the render than in the reference.
problem.cause: The image is drawn with that object plumb on screen, ignoring the roll its camera needs elsewhere.
problem.fix: Tip the object to match the picture; record it as a per-object correction.
problem.detect: Edge overlay: the object's verticals cross the reference's at an angle while the rest aligns.
